Figure B : Floor Plan of the Ground Floor for Wang Cheong House

5. On the ground floor, there was a bicycle parking space consisting of two compartments. There were two ceiling mounted lighting and a CCTV near the compartment closer the Lightwell Platform (Photo G1 to G2). The lighting and the CCTV were seriously burnt by fire externally (Photo G3 to G4). Besides, there were an electrical distribution board with cables, two ceiling mounted lighting and an outdoor unit of air conditioner in the compartment further away from the Lightwell Platform (Photo G5 to G6). These electrical installations were relatively intact but affected by external fire slightly. There was no sign of electrical fault identified from these fixed electrical installations. No electrical product was found in bicycle parking space near the Lightwell Platform. There was no evidence to show the fire was initiated from fixed electrical installation in bicycle parking space and the fire is not electrically related.
